scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Three Wheeler with Ice Box Including E-rickshaws for Fish Vending - Haryana
description:
The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana is a significant initiative launched by the Government of India to enhance the fishery sector in the country. 

This scheme was officially launched on September 29, 2020. 

The primary objective of the scheme is to promote sustainable and responsible fishing practices. 

It aims to increase fish production and productivity in the country. 

The scheme also focuses on improving the livelihoods of fishers and fish farmers. 

One of the specific components of this scheme is the provision of three-wheelers with ice boxes. 

These vehicles are intended for fish vending purposes. 

The inclusion of e-rickshaws in this initiative is aimed at promoting environmentally friendly transportation. 

The government has set a target to increase fish production to 22 million metric tons by 2024. 

This is a significant increase from the 13.7 million metric tons produced in 2018-2019. 

The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to fish vendors for the purchase of these three-wheelers. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme can go up to 60 percent of the total cost of the vehicle. 

The maximum subsidy amount is capped at ₹1.5 lakh per vehicle. 

This subsidy is aimed at reducing the financial burden on fish vendors. 

The scheme also aims to create a robust supply chain for fish distribution. 

It is expected to enhance the income of fish vendors by providing them with better transportation facilities. 

The eligibility criteria for availing of the benefits under this scheme include being a registered fish vendor. 

Applicants must be engaged in the fish vending business for a minimum of three years. 

The age limit for applicants is set between 18 years and 60 years. 

The income of the applicant should not exceed ₹5 lakh per annum. 

The application process involves several steps. 

First, interested applicants must visit the official website of the Fisheries Department of Haryana. 

They need to fill out the application form available online. 

The application form requires details such as personal information, business information, and financial details. 

Applicants must also submit documents such as identity proof, address proof, and income certificate. 

A registration certificate as a fish vendor is also mandatory. 

Once the application is submitted, it will be reviewed by the concerned authorities. 

The review process typically takes about 15 to 30 days. 

Upon approval, the financial assistance will be disbursed directly to the bank account of the applicant. 

The disbursement is expected to occur within 15 days after approval. 

The implementing authority for this scheme in Haryana is the Fisheries Department. 

The department is responsible for the overall implementation and monitoring of the scheme. 

Contact details for the Fisheries Department can be found on the official Haryana government website. 

The scheme also aims to promote skill development among fish vendors. 

Training programs will be organized to educate vendors on best practices in fish handling and transportation. 

This is crucial for maintaining the quality and freshness of fish products. 

The government also aims to create awareness about the nutritional benefits of fish consumption. 

This is part of a broader initiative to promote fish as a healthy food option. 

The scheme is expected to benefit thousands of fish vendors across Haryana. 

It is anticipated that the increase in fish production will also lead to job creation in the sector. 

The government has allocated a budget of ₹20,000 crore for the entire Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana. 

This budget is intended to cover various components of the scheme, including the three-wheeler subsidy. 

The scheme aligns with the government’s vision of doubling farmers' income by 2022. 

It also supports the goals of the National Fisheries Policy. 

The policy aims to achieve sustainable development in the fisheries sector. 

The scheme is expected to have a multiplier effect on the economy. 

It will enhance the livelihoods of fishers and contribute to food security. 

The initiative is also in line with the Atmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyan. 

This initiative promotes self-reliance in various sectors, including fisheries. 

The scheme is expected to improve the overall infrastructure for fish marketing. 

It aims to reduce post-harvest losses in the fish supply chain. 

The introduction of ice boxes in three-wheelers will help in preserving the quality of fish. 

This is particularly important in hot weather conditions. 

The scheme also encourages the use of technology in the fish vending business. 

The government may introduce mobile applications for better tracking of fish supply and demand. 

This will help vendors optimize their operations and increase profitability. 

The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana is a comprehensive approach to revitalizing the fisheries sector. 

It addresses various challenges faced by fish vendors and aims to create a sustainable ecosystem. 

The scheme is a testament to the government's commitment to the welfare of fishers and fish farmers. 

It reflects a strategic move towards enhancing food security and economic stability in the country. 

The expected outcomes of the scheme include increased fish production, improved livelihoods, and enhanced nutritional security. 

Overall, the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana is a pivotal initiative for the growth of the fisheries sector in India. 

It is designed to empower fish vendors and create a sustainable fishing environment. 

The scheme has the potential to transform the livelihoods of many individuals involved in the fishery sector. 

It is a significant step towards achieving the goals of sustainable development in India.
